## The problem

What are you trying to do that Storybench does not currently support? Describe
the need, not just the solution.

## Proposed solution

What you would like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds or other approaches you have tried or thought about.

## Additional context

Screenshots, examples, or related issues.

> [!NOTE]
> Storybench is an early-stage, local, single-creator project. Large or
> architectural proposals are best discussed in an issue before any
> implementation.
